# Wormhole Token Bridge completeTransfer test vectors

Calls to `completeTransfer(bytes)` on the Wormhole Token Bridge on Ethereum.

```solidity
// encodedVm: a packed signed message (VAA)
function completeTransfer(bytes memory encodedVm) public;
```

Descriptor: [`example-wormhole-token-bridge.json`](./example-wormhole-token-bridge.json)

All vectors are sent by `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` to `0x3ee18B2214AFF97000D974cf647E7C347E8fa585` on Ethereum.

## USDC returning from Solana

Signatures are dummies. Amounts are not scaled to the token's decimals.

Arguments:

```
encodedVm: abi.encodePacked(...)
  version: 1
  guardianSetIndex: 4
  numSignatures: 13
  signatures: 13 entries of guardianIndex (1 byte), r (32), s (32), v (1); dummy values
  timestamp: 1791892800
  nonce: 0
  emitterChainId: 1
  emitterAddress: 0xec7372995d5cc8732397fb0ad35c0121e0eaa90d26f828a534cab54391b3a4f5
  sequence: 123456
  consistencyLevel: 32
  payload: abi.encodePacked(...)
    payloadId: 0x01
    amount: 1000000000
    tokenAddress: 0x000000000000000000000000a0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48
    tokenChain: 2
    to: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    toChain: 2
    fee: 0
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Intent: Complete cross-chain transfer
Signed at: 2026-10-13 12:00:00 UTC
Origin chain (Wormhole ID): 1
Origin emitter: 0xec7372995d5cc8732397fb0ad35c0121e0eaa90d26f828a534cab54391b3a4f5
Amount: 1000000000
Token (origin chain address): 0x000000000000000000000000a0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48
Token's origin chain (Wormhole ID): 2
Recipient: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Destination chain (Wormhole ID): 2
Relayer fee: 0
```

## Wrapped SOL arriving from Solana, with a relayer fee

`tokenAddress` is a Solana mint. The amount has 8 decimals.

Arguments:

```
encodedVm: abi.encodePacked(...)
  version: 1
  guardianSetIndex: 4
  numSignatures: 13
  signatures: 13 entries of guardianIndex (1 byte), r (32), s (32), v (1); dummy values
  timestamp: 1791892800
  nonce: 0
  emitterChainId: 1
  emitterAddress: 0xec7372995d5cc8732397fb0ad35c0121e0eaa90d26f828a534cab54391b3a4f5
  sequence: 123456
  consistencyLevel: 32
  payload: abi.encodePacked(...)

    amount: 2500000000
    tokenAddress: 0x069b8857feab8184fb687f634618c035dac439dc1aeb3b5598a0f00000000001

    toChain: 2
```

## Transfer with payload

Payload type 3 is completed with `completeTransferWithPayload`, so it is rejected here.

Arguments:

```
encodedVm: abi.encodePacked(...)
  version: 1
  guardianSetIndex: 4
  numSignatures: 13
  signatures: 13 entries of guardianIndex (1 byte), r (32), s (32), v (1); dummy values
  timestamp: 1791892800
  nonce: 0
  emitterChainId: 1
  emitterAddress: 0xec7372995d5cc8732397fb0ad35c0121e0eaa90d26f828a534cab54391b3a4f5
  sequence: 123456
  consistencyLevel: 32
  payload: abi.encodePacked(...)
    payloadId: 0x03
    amount: 1000000
    tokenAddress: 0x000000000000000000000000a0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48
    tokenChain: 2
    to: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    toChain: 2
    fromAddress: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
    payload: 0x6869
```

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```
Rejected: no case for value 0x03
```
